record_key: ph_product_guide::Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank)::0
title: Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank)
content: Liwanag Kalinga Protect is a regular-pay life insurance plan of Liwanag Life Assurance, offered to Sinag Bank depositors through Sinag Bank branches. Premiums are paid for 10 years and coverage continues up to age 100.

source.section: Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank)

record_key: ph_product_guide::Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank)/Life insurance coverage::0
title: Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank) > Life insurance coverage
content: The plan pays the face amount to the named beneficiaries if the insured dies while the policy is in force. Face amounts start at ₱500,000. The face amount, premium and payment mode of each policy are shown in the policy data page.

record_key: ph_product_guide::Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank)/Cash value::0
title: Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank) > Cash value
content: The policy builds a guaranteed cash value starting from the end of the third policy year. The cash value can be used for the Automatic Premium Loan, a policy loan, or received as a surrender value if the policy is cancelled.

record_key: ph_product_guide::Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank)/Riders::0
title: Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank) > Riders
content:
Optional riders can be attached at purchase or on a policy anniversary, subject to underwriting:
- Accidental Death Benefit rider: pays an additional amount equal to the rider face amount if death is due to an accident.
- Critical Illness rider: pays an advance of 50% of the face amount on first diagnosis of one of 30 covered critical illnesses.
- Waiver of Premium on Disability rider: future premiums are waived if the insured becomes totally and permanently disabled before age 60.

record_key: ph_product_guide::Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank)/Beneficiaries::0
title: Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank) > Beneficiaries
content: The policyholder names one or more beneficiaries and their share of the benefit. A revocable beneficiary can be changed by the policyholder at any time by submitting a Change of Beneficiary form at any Sinag Bank branch or Liwanag Life service center, with a valid ID. Changing an irrevocable beneficiary requires the written consent of that beneficiary. Beneficiary changes cannot be processed over a phone call.

record_key: ph_product_guide::Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank)/Coverage while premiums are unpaid::0
title: Liwanag Kalinga Protect - Product Guide (Bancassurance via Sinag Bank) > Coverage while premiums are unpaid
content: Coverage stays in force during the 31-day grace period. If the insured dies during the grace period, the benefit is paid less the unpaid premium.

record_key: ph_payment_lapse::Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement/Premium due date and payment modes::0
title: Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement > Premium due date and payment modes
content: Premiums are due on the policy's modal due date shown in the policy data page. Payment modes are annual, semi-annual, quarterly or monthly. The payment mode can be changed on any policy anniversary by submitting a Change of Mode request; monthly mode requires Sinag Bank auto-debit enrollment.

source.section: Premium due date and payment modes

record_key: ph_payment_lapse::Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement/Payment channels::0
title: Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement > Payment channels
content:
Premiums can be paid through any of these channels:
- Sinag Bank auto-debit from the policyholder's savings or checking account (recommended).
- Sinag Bank mobile app or online banking under Bills Payment, biller "Liwanag Life", using the 10-digit policy number as reference.
- Over the counter at any Sinag Bank branch using a bills payment slip.
- Liwanag Life customer portal using a credit or debit card.
Payments are posted to the policy within 2 banking days. An official receipt is sent by email or SMS after posting.

record_key: ph_payment_lapse::Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement/Failed auto-debit::0
title: Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement > Failed auto-debit
content: If auto-debit fails because of insufficient balance, the bank retries the debit on the 3rd and 7th day after the due date. The policyholder can also pay through any other channel during the grace period.

record_key: ph_payment_lapse::Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement/Grace period::0
title: Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement > Grace period
content: A grace period of 31 days from the due date is given for every premium after the first. The policy stays in force during the grace period. No interest or penalty is charged if the premium is paid within the grace period.

record_key: ph_payment_lapse::Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement/Automatic Premium Loan::0
title: Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement > Automatic Premium Loan
content: If the Automatic Premium Loan (APL) option is active and the policy has enough cash value, an unpaid premium at the end of the grace period is paid automatically as a loan against the cash value. APL loans charge interest of 8% per year and reduce the benefit if unpaid.

record_key: ph_payment_lapse::Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement/Lapse::0
title: Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement > Lapse
content: If the premium is still unpaid at the end of the grace period and APL does not apply, the policy lapses. A lapsed policy provides no life insurance coverage and riders also stop.

record_key: ph_payment_lapse::Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement/Reinstatement::0
title: Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement > Reinstatement
content: A lapsed policy can be reinstated within 3 years from the date of lapse by submitting a reinstatement application, evidence of insurability (a health declaration, and medical exams if required), and paying all unpaid premiums with interest of 8% per year. Reinstatement is subject to approval by Liwanag Life underwriting.

record_key: ph_payment_lapse::Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement/Hardship options::0
title: Premium Payment, Grace Period, Lapse and Reinstatement > Hardship options
content: Policyholders facing temporary financial difficulty can request a change to a lower payment frequency on the next anniversary, use the APL if available, or request a review of the face amount with a Liwanag financial advisor. Premium holidays or discounts are not offered.

record_key: ph_objections::Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)::0
title: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)
content: Tone: warm, respectful and unhurried. Use "po" and "opo" with all customers. Mirror the customer's language: Filipino, English or Taglish. Never shame the customer about a late payment and never threaten lapse; explain it as information.

source.section: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)

record_key: ph_objections::Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)/"Wala pa akong pera ngayon" (I do not have money right now)::0
title: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines) > "Wala pa akong pera ngayon" (I do not have money right now)
content:
Acknowledge the situation first. Explain that the policy is still covered during the 31-day grace period and there is no penalty if paid within the grace period. Ask for a target payment date within the grace period. If the customer cannot pay within the grace period, mention the Automatic Premium Loan if the policy has it, or offer a callback from a Liwanag financial advisor to review options.
Sample phrasing: "Naiintindihan ko po. Covered pa rin po kayo hanggang sa end ng grace period, at walang penalty basta mabayaran within that period. Kailan po kaya kayo makakapag-settle?"

source.section: "Wala pa akong pera ngayon" (I do not have money right now)

record_key: ph_objections::Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)/"Ipa-cancel ko na lang ang policy" (I want to cancel the policy)::0
title: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines) > "Ipa-cancel ko na lang ang policy" (I want to cancel the policy)
content: Do not argue. Acknowledge, then explain that cancelling ends the life coverage for the family and that a new policy later may cost more because of age and health. Cancellation and surrender requests cannot be processed on a reminder call; refer the customer to a retention specialist or Liwanag financial advisor (human handoff).

source.section: "Ipa-cancel ko na lang ang policy" (I want to cancel the policy)

record_key: ph_objections::Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)/"Hindi ko naman nagagamit" (I never use it)::0
title: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines) > "Hindi ko naman nagagamit" (I never use it)
content: Life insurance protects the beneficiaries; it is not meant to be used every year. Remind the customer of the beneficiaries named in the policy only if identity has been verified. Mention that the policy builds cash value from the third policy year.

source.section: "Hindi ko naman nagagamit" (I never use it)

record_key: ph_objections::Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)/"Bakit ako sinisingil, naka-auto-debit ako" (I am enrolled in auto-debit)::0
title: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines) > "Bakit ako sinisingil, naka-auto-debit ako" (I am enrolled in auto-debit)
content: Explain that the debit can fail when the account balance is insufficient on the due date and that the bank retries on the 3rd and 7th day after the due date. Suggest keeping enough balance or paying through the Sinag Bank app.

source.section: "Bakit ako sinisingil, naka-auto-debit ako" (I am enrolled in auto-debit)

record_key: ph_objections::Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)/"Tumaas ba ang premium?" (Did my premium increase?)::0
title: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines) > "Tumaas ba ang premium?" (Did my premium increase?)
content: The premium of Kalinga Protect is level: it does not increase during the 10-year payment period. A different amount usually means a rider was added or the payment mode changed.

source.section: "Tumaas ba ang premium?" (Did my premium increase?)

record_key: ph_objections::Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines)/"Busy ako, tawag na lang ulit" (I am busy, call again)::0
title: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines) > "Busy ako, tawag na lang ulit" (I am busy, call again)
content: Respect it. Offer a callback at the customer's preferred day and time within the grace period.

source.section: "Busy ako, tawag na lang ulit" (I am busy, call again)

record_key: ph_bank_referral::Sinag Bank Referral for Coverage Review/When to offer a bank referral::0
title: Sinag Bank Referral for Coverage Review > When to offer a bank referral
content: Offer a bank referral when the customer asks about more coverage, a plan for a family member, adding a rider, education or retirement planning, or when they want to discuss options in person.

source.section: When to offer a bank referral

record_key: ph_bank_referral::Sinag Bank Referral for Coverage Review/How the referral works::0
title: Sinag Bank Referral for Coverage Review > How the referral works
content: With the customer's consent, the agent logs a referral to the Sinag Bank branch of the customer's choice. A Liwanag financial advisor assigned to that branch contacts the customer within 2 banking days to schedule a coverage review. The review is free and there is no obligation to buy.

record_key: ph_bank_referral::Sinag Bank Referral for Coverage Review/What the agent must not do::0
title: Sinag Bank Referral for Coverage Review > What the agent must not do
content: The agent must not quote premiums for new plans, must not promise approval of riders or new policies, and must not collect government ID numbers or bank account details over the phone.

source.section: What the agent must not do
